name: TM7 Lamb Meatball, Fresh Red Pepper & Feta Rigatoni Bake
ingredients: 110 g fresh white breadcrumbs for meatballs
4 g salt, plus extra for pasta water
1 g ground black pepper, plus extra to taste
450 g fresh red peppers (around 3 large), deseeded and chopped
1200 g chopped tomatoes (3 x 400 g tins)
Up to 150 g reserved pasta cooking water

steps.text: Combine 800 g lamb mince, 110 g breadcrumbs, 2 egg yolks, 1/2 tsp chilli flakes, 4 g salt and 1 g pepper in a large bowl. Mix gently and shape into 16 meatballs.
Preheat air fryer to 200°C. Toss 450 g deseeded fresh red peppers with 10 g olive oil. Air fry 15-18 minutes at 200°C, shaking halfway, until soft and lightly charred. Set aside.
Set air fryer to 190°C. Cook meatballs in a single layer in batches if needed for 10-12 minutes, turning halfway, until browned. They will finish cooking in the oven.
Place 180 g onion and 15 g garlic in TM7 mixing bowl. Chop 5 sec / speed 5. Scrape down.
Add the remaining 20 g olive oil. Cook 6 min / 120°C / speed 1.
Add 450 g air-fried fresh red peppers and 1200 g chopped tomatoes. Ensure ingredients are below the maximum fill mark. Cook 15 min / 100°C / speed 1.
Carefully blend the hot sauce, gradually increasing speed from 5 to 6 over 30 seconds, following TM7 safety instructions.
Add 60 g double cream and season to taste. Cook 2 min / 90°C / speed 2.
Meanwhile, boil 500 g rigatoni in salted water for 2 minutes less than the packet cooking time. Reserve up to 150 g cooking water and drain.

Heat oven to 200°C fan. Toss pasta with the fresh pepper tomato sauce and 125 g crumbled feta in a large baking dish. Nestle in meatballs, then scatter over remaining 125 g feta and 50 g fresh breadcrumbs. Add a little reserved pasta water if needed.
Bake uncovered for 18-22 minutes at 200°C fan until bubbling, golden and meatballs reach 75°C in their centres. Rest 5 minutes and garnish with 15 g fresh basil.
